name: ZX_RATES_B
description: This table stores tax rates and the related attributes for multiple configuration owners. Each row stores a rate that is effective for a specific period and is applicable to a specific tax status or tax jurisdiction.

columns.name: TAX_RATE_CODE
columns.description: Tax rate code

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_FROM
columns.description: Effective from date

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_TO
columns.description: Effective to date

columns.name: TAX_REGIME_CODE
columns.description: Tax regime code for this rate

columns.name: TAX
columns.description: Tax for which this rate is defined

columns.name: TAX_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Tax status code for which this rate is defined

columns.name: SCHEDULE_BASED_RATE_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether this rate has multiple schedules

columns.name: RATE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Lookup code to indicate whether this rate is a percentage rate, a quantity based rate, a schedule based rate or a recovery rate

columns.name: PERCENTAGE_RATE
columns.description: Column to record rate value if this is a percentage rate

columns.name: QUANTITY_RATE
columns.description: Column to record rate value if this is a quantity based rate

columns.name: UOM_CODE
columns.description: Unit of measure code for this rate. This column is applicable only for quantity based rates.

columns.name: TAX_JURISDICTION_CODE
columns.description: Tax jurisdiction code for which this rate is defined

columns.name: RECOVERY_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Default recovery type code for which this rate is defined

columns.name: ACTIVE_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether this rate is active

columns.name: DEFAULT_RATE_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether this is the default rate code for the status or jurisdiction

columns.name: DEFAULT_FLG_EFFECTIVE_FROM
columns.description: Effective start date from which this is the default rate code for the status or jurisdiction

columns.name: DEFAULT_FLG_EFFECTIVE_TO
columns.description: Effective end date till when this is the default rate code for the status or jurisdiction

columns.name: DEFAULT_REC_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Recovery type code for the default recovery rate code associated with this rate. This column is applicable only for status based rates.

columns.name: DEFAULT_REC_RATE_CODE
columns.description: Default recovery rate code associated with this rate. This column is applicable only for status based rates.

columns.name: OFFSET_TAX
columns.description: Tax of the offset rate code associated with this tax rate

columns.name: OFFSET_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Tax status code of the offset rate code associated with this tax rate

columns.name: OFFSET_TAX_RATE_CODE
columns.description: Offset tax rate code associated with this tax rate

columns.name: RECOVERY_RULE_CODE
columns.description: Recovery rule code if this is a recovery rate

columns.name: DEF_REC_SETTLEMENT_OPTION_CODE
columns.description: Lookup code to indicate whether an input tax can be recovered when an invoice is recorded or only when the invoice is paid and whether an output tax is due for settlement when the invoice is issued or only when the payment is received against it.

columns.name: VAT_TRANSACTION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: VAT transaction type code used to group invoices

columns.name: RECORD_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Lookup code to indicate whether the record is migrated, seeded or defined by the user

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: INPUT_IC_AP_TAX_RATE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the Input Tax Rate Code to be used for Inter-company Payables transactions

columns.name: PROGRAM_LOGIN_ID
columns.description: Login user identifier of last concurrent program to update this record

columns.name: TAX_RATE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier

columns.name: CONTENT_OWNER_ID
columns.description: Party tax profile identifier for configuration owner of this rate

columns.name: ADJ_FOR_ADHOC_AMT_CODE
columns.description: Lookup code to identify whether tax rate or taxable basis is to be adjusted when tax amount is changed for tax lines with adhoc tax rate

columns.name: ALLOW_ADHOC_TAX_RATE_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether adhoc tax rates are allowed for this tax rate

columns.name: TAX_CLASS
columns.description: Column to indicate whether this tax code is applicable for Procure To Pay business flows or Order To Cash business flows. Possible values are INPUT and OUTPUT. NULL indicates it is applicable to both.

columns.name: SOURCE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the tax code in AR_VAT_TAX_ALL or AP_TAX_CODES_ALL of prior releases for migrated records.

columns.name: TAXABLE_BASIS_FORMULA_CODE
columns.description: Formula code to determine taxable base amount

columns.name: INCLUSIVE_TAX_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether this tax rate is tax inclusive by default

columns.name: TAX_INCLUSIVE_OVERRIDE_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether the tax inclusive flag can be overridden at tax line level

columns.name: ALLOW_EXEMPTIONS_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates if exemtpions are allowed for this rate

columns.name: ALLOW_EXCEPTIONS_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates if exemtpions are allowed for this rate

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Tax rate description

columns.name: PROGRAM_NAME
columns.description: Program name of last concurrent program to update this record

columns.name: PROGRAM_APP_NAME
columns.description: Application name of last concurrent program to update this record
